summary: 3/4 checks passed — 1 fix generated (check 6.2: module instantiation reconciliation)
findings: 6.2 BLOCKER: promotion_report.md accounts for 16 modules (12 PROMOTED + 3 CONDITIONAL PROMOTE + 1 BLOCKED) but rtl/trash_robot_soc.v instantiates 15 module types, of which one is the BLOCKED picorv32_core. One PROMOTED or CONDITIONAL module is therefore unmapped and unverified. The supplied evidence asserts a complete 15/15 mapping, but that mapping contains only 14 non-blocked modules — the assertion contradicts its own roster.

6.2 INTEGRITY: picorv32_core carries a BLOCKED verdict (unresolved alu_add failure, TB dispute carried over from v5) yet is instantiated at rtl/trash_robot_soc.v lines 81-107 and appears in the synthesized netlist. A BLOCKED module is shipping inside the SoC top with no recorded waiver.

INTEGRITY (reporting): soc_integration_report.md claims 'Verilator (0 errors, 3 warnings)' but the Verilator log exits with '%Error: Exiting due to 3 warning(s)'. The report's characterization does not match the tool's exit behavior. This does not fall under mandatory check 6.3 (which scopes to synth/*.log), but the integration report's self-verdict of PASS rests in part on a claim its own log contradicts.

SoC-level formal verification is absent: trash_robot_soc_bmc, trash_robot_soc_cover, and trash_robot_soc_induction all report FAIL/MISSING with no PASS file. Not a mandatory Stage 6 check, but the SoC top has no formal evidence at all.

6.4 CONTEXT (not a failure): v6 at 27,213 cells passes against the v5 baseline of 26,798, but v5 itself was the regression (v4 55K → v5 26K). Measuring v6 against the regressed baseline ratifies that drop rather than detecting it — v6 is ~49% of v4's cell count. The rubric explicitly names v5 (26,798) as the comparison point, so this check passes as written; flagging for Vera in case the intended baseline was pre-regression v4.

fixes.description: Reconcile promotion_report.md module roster against top-level instantiations and identify the one unmapped promoted/conditional module
fixes.action: 1. Extract the authoritative module roster from the promotion report, separated by verdict: run the grep below to list every module name with its PROMOTED / CONDITIONAL PROMOTE / BLOCKED verdict. 2. Diff that roster against the 15 instantiated module types in rtl/trash_robot_soc.v. 3. For the promoted/conditional module that has no instantiation, either (a) instantiate it in rtl/trash_robot_soc.v with its Wishbone hookup into wb_interconnect and re-run synthesis, or (b) if it is intentionally out of scope for v6, downgrade its promotion_report.md verdict from PROMOTED/CONDITIONAL to DEFERRED with a written rationale so the roster and the RTL agree. 4. Separately, resolve the BLOCKED picorv32_core: a BLOCKED module must not ship inside the SoC top with an unresolved alu_add failure. Either close the TB dispute and re-promote it, or record an explicit signed waiver in promotion_report.md authorizing integration of a BLOCKED core. 5. Re-run this audit once the roster and the RTL are 1:1.
